verdict.rationale: Lago documents an explicit API versioning policy (v1) specifying that clients should tolerate additive changes like new fields, enums, endpoints, and webhook event types, indicating a stable versioned API contract with deprecation-safe evolution rules, and backs this with a published OpenAPI 3.1 schema. Missing for 10: an explicit deprecation/sunset timeline policy (e.g., how long old versions are supported) and independent/community confirmation of version stability in practice.
